spans.s: शुद्ध (I) a. (f. द्धा) 1. Pure, purified, अंतःशुद्धस्त्वमपि भविता वर्णमात्रेण कृष्णः Megh.i.49; 2. stainless, innocent, honest, chaste, R.xiv.14; 3. faultless, correct; 4. bright; 5. acquitted; 6. simple, unmixed, mere; 7. admitted, authorized; 8. sharp, whetted.
शुद्ध (II) m. An epithet of Śiva.
शुद्ध (III) n. 1. Pure spirit; 2. rock salt; 3. black pepper.

शुद्ध (I) a. (f. द्धा) 1. Pure, purified, अंतःशुद्धस्त्वमपि भविता वर्णमात्रेण कृष्णः Megh.i.49; 2. stainless, innocent, honest, chaste, R.xiv.14; 3. faultless, correct; 4. bright; 5. acquitted; 6. simple, unmixed, mere; 7. admitted, authorized; 8. sharp, whetted.
शुद्ध-अंत m. a king’s private apartments, a harem, a seraglio, स तैराक्रमयामास शुद्धांतं शुद्धकर्मभिः K.S.vi.52.
शुद्ध-अंता f. a king’s wife.
शुद्ध-अंत˚चारिन् m. an attendant of the private apartments.
शुद्ध-अंत˚पालक m. a guard of the private apartments.
शुद्धोदन m. name of the father of Śākyamuni.
शुद्धोदन˚सुत m. an epithet of Śākyamuni.
शुद्ध-चैतन्य n. pure intelligence.
शुद्ध-जंघ m. an ass.

शुद्धि f. 1. Purification, योगिनः कर्म कुर्वंति संगं त्यक्त्वात्मशुद्धये M.v.10, R.i.85; 2. purity, cleanness, holiness; 3. an expiation, an expiatory act, शरीरत्यागमात्रेण शुद्धिलाभममन्यत R.xii.10; 4. paying off arrears; 6. retaliation (as in वैरशुद्धि); 7. innocence, acquittal (in law); 8. correctness, truth, accuracy; 9. subtraction; 10. brightness, lustre, sheen, त एव मुक्तागुणशुद्धयोऽपि हर्म्येषु मूर्च्छंति न चंद्रपादाः R.xvi.18; 11. an epithet of Durgā.
शुद्धि-पत्र n. 1. a list of errata; 2. a certificate of purification by means of penance.
शूद्र m. A man of the fourth or survile tribe; (the Śūdra, is said to have been born from the feet of Purusha in R.V.x.90; his business was to serve the three higher castes, M.i.91).
शूद्रा f. A woman of the Śūdra tribe.
शूद्र-आह्निक n. the daily rites of a Śūdra.
शूद्र-उदक n. water polluted by the touch of a Śūdra.
शूद्र-धर्म m. the duties of a Śūdra.
शूद्र-प्रिय m. an onion.
शूद्र-प्रेष्य m. a man of any of the three superior castes who has become a servant to a Śūdra.
शूद्र-याजक m. one who conducts a sacrifice for a Śūdra.
शूद्र-वर्ग m. the Śūdra class.
शूद्र-सेवन n. the being a servant of a Śūdra.
शूद्रक m. Name of a king, the reported author of the Mricchakaṭikā.
शूद्रा-भार्य m. one who has a Śūdra woman for his wife.
शूद्रा-वेदन n. the marrying a Śūdra woman.
शूद्राणी f. The wife of a Śūdra.
शूद्राणी f. The wife of a Śūdra.
सुदक्षिण a. (f. णा) 1. Very sincere or upright; 2. liberal in sacrificial gifts.
सुदक्षिण a. (f. णा) 1. Very sincere or upright; 2. liberal in sacrificial gifts.
सुदक्षिणा f. Name of the wife of Dilīpa, R.iii.1, ii.64.
सुदंड m. A cane.
सुदत् a. (f. ती) Having handsome teeth.
सुदत् a. (f. ती) Having handsome teeth.
सुदंत m. 1. A good tooth; 2. an actor, a dancer.
सुदंती f. The female elephant presiding over the north-west quarter.
सुदर्शन (I) a. (f. ना or नी) 1. Beautiful, handsome; 2. easily seen.
सुदर्शन (II) m. 1. The discus of Viṣṇu; 2. a vulture.
सुदर्शन (III) n. A name of Jambūdvīpa.
सुदर्शन (I) a. (f. ना or नी) 1. Beautiful, handsome; 2. easily seen.
सुदर्शना f. 1. A handsome woman; 2. a woman; 3. an order, a command.
सुदर्शन (I) a. (f. ना or नी) 1. Beautiful, handsome; 2. easily seen.
सुदा a. Very bountiful.
सूद m. 1. Destroying, destruction, massacre; 2. pouring out, distilling; 3. a well, a spring; 4. a cook; 5. sauce, soup; 6. anything seasoned; 7. split pease; 8. mud, mire; 9. sin, fault.
सुदामन् (I) a. One who gives liberally.
सुदामन् (II) m. 1. A cloud; 2. the sea; 3. name of a mountain; 4. name of Indra’s elephant; 5. name of a poor Brāhmaṇa who came to Dvārakā to ask Kṛṣṇa’s aid and was raised to wealth.
सुदाय m. 1. An auspicious gift; 2. a special gift given on particular solemn occasions.
सुदि ind. In the light fortnight of a lunar month.
सुदिन n. An auspicious day.
सुदिन-अह n. the same as सुदिन q.v.
सुदीर्घा f. A kind of cucumber.
सुदूर a. (f. रा) Very distant.(सुदूरम् is used as an indeclinable in the sense of ‘in a very high degree’ or ‘to a great distance’; सुदूरात् ‘from a great distance.’)
सुदूर a. (f. रा) Very distant.(सुदूरम् is used as an indeclinable in the sense of ‘in a very high degree’ or ‘to a great distance’; सुदूरात् ‘from a great distance.’)
सुदृश् (I) a. Having beautiful eyes.
सुदृश् (II) f. A pretty woman.
सूद् (I) vt. 1Ā (pres. सूदते) 1. To strike, to hurt, to wound, to kill, to destroy; 2. to effuse, to pour out; 3. to deposit.

सूद् (II) vt. 10U (pres. सूदयति-ते) 1. To incite, to urge on, to animate; 2. to strike, to wound, to kill, to massacre; 3. to cook, to dress, to season, to prepare; 4. to pour out, to effuse; 5. to assent, to agree, to promise.With अभि- or नि-, to kill.
सूद-अध्यक्ष m. superintendent of the kitchen.
सूद-कर्मन् n. cookery.
सूद-शाला f. a kitchen.
सूदन (I) a. (f. नी) 1. Destroying, destructive, R.ix.3; 2. dear, beloved.
सूदन (II) n. 1. The act of destroying, destruction; 2. assenting to, promising; 3. ejecting, throwing away.
सूदन (I) a. (f. नी) 1. Destroying, destructive, R.ix.3; 2. dear, beloved.
